SiteCheck — Privacy Policy

Product by DNATech · Effective October 25, 2026
Executive Summary: SiteCheck is a local-first developer utility. All website audits, DOM inspections, heading tree analyses, and link status checks run 100% locally on your machine. We do not operate tracking servers, we do not collect personal information, and we never sell or transmit your data to third parties.

1. Local Processing Guarantee

When you click the SiteCheck extension icon, the extension temporarily reads the Document Object Model (DOM) of the webpage in your active browser tab. This process inspects:

  • Metadata: <title>, description, canonical link, viewport, and OpenGraph/Twitter cards.
  • Headings Outline: H1 through H6 structure and hierarchy sequence.
  • Images: Media URLs, dimensions, and alternative text presence.
  • Hyperlinks: Anchor texts and destination targets.
  • WordPress Indicators: Publicly exposed version tags, asset paths, and plugin footprints.

This data is held only in transient browser memory to render the visual report. None of this information is uploaded, logged, or transferred to any external server.

2. Chrome Permissions & Usage

In accordance with Chrome Web Store Minimal Permissions guidelines, SiteCheck requests only three scoped permissions:

Permission Technical Justification
activeTab Grants temporary access to inspect the DOM of only the current page when you click the extension icon. It never grants continuous or background browsing tracking.
scripting Allows the extension to inject the client-side audit engine and the interactive neon element highlighter onto the active webpage.
storage Enables saving your audit logs and custom SEO threshold preferences locally on your computer via chrome.storage.local.

3. Data Storage & Retention

Audit reports and settings are saved exclusively in your browser's private local storage (chrome.storage.local). This data is completely private to your computer profile. You can delete individual reports or wipe the entire history log at any time with one click in the History panel.

4. Third-Party Disclosures & Analytics

SiteCheck contains zero third-party analytics trackers, zero advertising scripts, and zero telemetry beacons. We comply fully with the Google Chrome Web Store Developer Program Policies.

5. Contact & Source Code

SiteCheck is an open, transparent project developed by DNATech. You can review the full source code and verify our privacy guarantees on our GitHub repository:

https://github.com/dnatech117/check-site
